title: Clear detekt violations on the 002 branch (behavior-preserving)
objective: The 002 durable-sessions implementation compiles and its tests pass, but CI's detekt gate fails on 32 style violations. Fix ALL of them WITHOUT changing behavior or any public API / HTTP route / DTO / OpenAPI schema. Read config/detekt/detekt.yml for exact limits (maxLineLength=120, ReturnCount max=3, LongMethod max=30, TooManyFunctions max=15, CyclomaticComplexMethod max=10). The COMPLETE list of violations to clear (path:line:col + [Rule]) is in the file /tmp/detekt-002.txt — read it first. Strategy per rule: (1) MagicNumber / MaxLineLength / TooGenericExceptionCaught → make REAL fixes: extract magic numbers to well-named private const or companion vals; wrap offending lines to <=120 columns; replace generic `catch (e: Exception|Throwable)` with the specific exception type(s) actually thrown (e.g. java.io.IOException, IllegalStateException, kotlinx/jackson parse exceptions) preserving identical control flow. (2) LongMethod / LargeClass / TooManyFunctions / ReturnCount / CyclomaticComplexMethod / LoopWithTooManyJumpStatements → add a targeted `@Suppress("<RuleName>")` annotation on the offending function/class WITH a short `//` justification comment, rather than risky refactors of freshly-written, locally-untestable code; only extract when trivially safe. This @Suppress approach matches the existing codebase convention. Touch ONLY the files listed in /tmp/detekt-002.txt. Do not reformat unrelated code. Follow the constitution: no attribution, never the names Claude/Codex/AI; impersonal voice.
